name: ADA CDT procedure codes for general dentistry (SAMPLE)
scope: SAMPLE dataset: the most commonly billed general-dentistry codes, for intake and treatment planning. CDT codes and descriptors are copyright (c) American Dental Association. Fee ranges are typical US ranges and vary by region and payer — they are shown for patient orientation only and are NOT a quote. Verify against the current-year CDT manual or practice-management software before submitting any claim. Durations are template scheduling defaults, not clinical guidance.
source: American Dental Association, Current Dental Terminology (CDT) 2026. Code numbers and nomenclature verified 2026-11-10 against public CDT 2026 references (https://dentalbillingassist.com/blog/posts/dental-cdt-codes-guide, https://www.dododentist.com/en/dental-codes/, https://dentalbilling.com/dental-codes-cdt-guide/). Fee ranges: ADA Survey of Dental Fees 2024/2025 via CareRoute and DentalCleaningCost, April-May 2026 (https://www.careroute.ai/costs/dental-cleaning-cost, https://dentalcleaningcost.com/without-insurance).
